title: Mike McDaniel: Calls for my firing come with the territory

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Mike McDaniel: Calls for my firing come with the territory
sources.description: Chargers head coach Jim Harbaugh said this week that offensive coordinator Mike McDaniel's job is not in jeopardy, but the former Dolphins head coach knows that won't necessarily stop people from pleading with Harbaugh to change his mind.
